steps.heading: The canvas
steps.text: An inline SVG you build with the model instead of upload — the grid overlay is the shared 10% coordinate frame you and the model both work in. The same canvas mechanism draws the diagrams at /mermaid.

steps.heading: Shared vocabulary & notes
steps.text: Two tabs the model keeps in sync as it works: vocabulary is for you — what the drawing is — and implementation notes are the model's own record of ids, structure, and conventions.

steps.heading: The conversation is the history
steps.text: Every request and reply lives here — there's no separate version list because the chat itself is the revision log. Scroll up to see how the drawing got to where it is.

steps.heading: Ask for a change
steps.text: Describe what you want in plain language — “draw a round green face with two eyes” — and send it. The canvas, the vocabulary, and any lint findings all update in place.
